newsitem.title: USA: CME live, feeder cattle end higher with hogs, corn.
newsitem.headline: CME live, feeder cattle end higher with hogs, corn.

text.p: Spillover demand from sharply higher to limit up hog futures and expectations of stronger beef prices lifted CME live cattle to mostly higher closes, traders said.
Feeder cattle futures also rose, bolstered by lower CBOT corn futures, traders said.
Live cattle closed 0.250 cent per lb higher to 0.050 lower with April up most at 68.075 cents. Feeder cattle ended 0.475 to 0.150 cent higher with May up 0.350 at 70.100 cents.

Live cattle firmed along with hog futures on word Japan may cut tariffs on imported pork sooner than the July 1 scheduled date. This added to further position rolling and support from expected bottoming in cash beef prices after a several-day slide, traders said.

"We continue to focus on what the retail value is going to be. The market believes that April is a seasonal up - the time when demand starts to firm up," said Don Roose, president of U.S. Commodities Inc.
Wholesale boxed beef prices declined again at noon but the volume of trade has increased in recent days which could indicate the market is near to bottoming, traders said.
The heavy-weight choice boxed beef fell another $0.79 per cwt at noon to $100.30, a drop of nearly $4.00 since March 26 and the lowest price since February 21.

Commercials were on both sides of June while funds again rolled poitions into June. However, R.J. O'Brien spread long April/short June and ABN Chicogo Corp spread long June/short August, pit sources said.
In live cattle options, there was continued liquidation of April 68 puts and calls. Locals actively spread June 60/62 puts and commercials sold June 65 calls, pit sources added.
Active rolling of April short positions into May by E.D.&F. Man pressured May below previous levels before that month rallied again at the close following lower corn futures, traded said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index dipped $0.07 to $70.08 per cwt after being up to its highest level in two months.

Cargill Investor Services bought May late after selling early. E.D.&F. Man again actively spread long April/short May until late. FIMAT Futures USA lightly spread long May/short April, pit sources said.
